typed_predicate: namespace + exact field name; decimal for numeric fields and string for other fields. InvoiceDate remains opaque source text, not a validated date.
state_predicate: namespace + field name + State; missing/invalid/valid. valid means parseability/presence only, not business correctness.
raw_predicate: namespace + field name + RawJSON preserves JSON scalar representation
key_presence_predicate: namespace + field name + KeyPresent distinguishes absent key from explicit null
unknown_handling: No policy decisions in mapper. Missing/invalid numeric values omit typed value but preserve state and raw. Future decision adapter must apply declared policy; absence of a SHACL violation is not automatically pass on unknown inputs.
parity: Equivalent normalized JSON metadata and mapping specification are shared in all offline arm previews. Executable decision runners remain pending.
limits: No cancellation or policy pass/fail features computed
Finite JSON scalar inputs only; nonfinite strings marked invalid in numeric fields
Shared runtime blank/number preprocessing, not independent evidence of RDF advantage
Mapping tests do not establish generated-SHACL execution
